interpretation: Own fixed-open body1, empty activity2..16 and foregroundmask17 govern the static open well. Three bent brass side fittings, two tall brass supports, one narrow rail/rib crosshead and one short pale post follow source and reviewed concept.
Hidden shaft lining/floor depth, support engineering, rib count, dimensions and material depths are authored. Generic Terran PB14 iris and ST14 technology tower do not establish Mauna operation.
scale_contract: 2x2 placement footprint, ground0, +Z up/-Y front. Cell-relative dimensions authored; metric launch corridor and missile socket are not calibrated.
